<Event xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/win/2004/08/events/event'><System><Provider Name='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell' Guid='{a0c1853b-5c40-4b15-8766-3cf1c58f985a}'/><EventID>4104</EventID><Version>1</Version><Level>5</Level><Task>2</Task><Opcode>15</Opcode><Keywords>0x0</Keywords><TimeCreated SystemTime='2026-04-21T23:11:23.6897941Z'/><EventRecordID>369</EventRecordID><Correlation ActivityID='{4ed4fa8c-d244-0002-3206-d54e44d2dc01}'/><Execution ProcessID='3020' ThreadID='5976'/><Channel>Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational</Channel><Computer>DESKTOP-AK0R2QL</Computer><Security UserID='S-1-5-21-1419731445-3156843934-2716133192-1001'/></System><EventData><Data Name='MessageNumber'>1</Data><Data Name='MessageTotal'>1</Data><Data Name='ScriptBlockText'>$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$cloudDir = "C:\LabLogs\Cloud"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $cloudDir -Force | Out-Null

$time1 = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-45).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
$time2 = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

$file = Join-Path $cloudDir "cloud_identity_$stamp.json"

$events = @(
    @{
        timestamp  = $time1
        user       = "j.smith@company.local"
        action     = "login_success"
        ip         = "112.198.100.2"
        location   = "Manila, Philippines"
        app        = "AzureAD"
        user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"
    },
    @{
        timestamp  = $time2
        user       = "j.smith@company.local"
        action     = "login_success"
        ip         = "89.208.29.1"
        location   = "Amsterdam, Netherlands"
        app        = "AzureAD"
        user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"
    }
)

$events | ForEach-Object {
    $_ | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
} | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[+] Impossible travel log written to $file" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[+] Wait 30-90 seconds, then search Splunk." -ForegroundColor Cyan</Data><Data Name='ScriptBlockId'>7c37b70e-5645-4195-b7fb-60ef807398ab</Data><Data Name='Path'>C:\Users\MLATech\Desktop\ticket1_impossible_travel.ps1</Data></EventData></Event>
